Designation factors inform the SFC's holistic assessment; they are not automatic triggers or substitutes for an operative designation. Footnote 7 addresses assessment below 50% of NAV.

Missing classification evidence must remain distinguishable from established absence of a classification basis. A false result establishes neither historical declassification nor permission to distribute; excluded LAFs are not thereby non-complex.

The 15% direct-investment limit in footnote 1 is separate from the aggregate 50% classification threshold. The supplied source does not establish exposure valuation, double-counting methodology, designation expiry, or automatic declassification.
